description: This file defines the 'ViewClassic' class, which extends 'SugarView'. It handles displaying views in the SuiteCRM system, loading specific PHP files based on actions and modules, and managing access control.

classes.name: ViewClassic
classes.description: A class responsible for handling classic view rendering in SuiteCRM, including access control and dynamic inclusion of PHP files based on actions and modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view type based on the action, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles displaying the view, including access control checks and dynamically including the appropriate PHP file for the requested action.
